subject: Proposed supportive plan for Lila Singh — legal & HR review
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Draft supportive plan for Lila — request for HR/legal review

Hi team,

I wanted to loop you in early on a supportive performance pathway I plan to initiate for my direct report, Lila Singh (IC, Data Platform). Over the last two quarters we've documented repeated missed delivery milestones and a decline in cross-team communication that has started to impact adjacent squads. Before I meet with Lila I want to ensure we use HR-approved language and that Legal has a quick look for anything that could be unintentionally problematic.

Attachments included: lila_singh_performance_summary_2027-04.pdf (summary of incidents/metrics), supportive_plan_draft_v1.docx (manager draft), evidence_timeline.zip (clipped examples).

High-level ask: can HR and Legal review the attached draft and suggest wording edits or process steps by end of the week? I want to keep the first coaching conversation supportive and outcome-oriented, with clear success metrics and a 60-day cadence.

Key points I want to preserve:
- Focus on observable behaviors and measurable goals (no conjecture about intent).
- Offer concrete supports (mentor pairing, weekly progress syncs, targeted training budget).
- Timeboxed plan (60 days) with checkpoints and escalation path.

If you prefer, I can redact the initial examples to omit sensitive PII before sharing more broadly.

Thanks,
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Engineering Manager, Data Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft supportive plan for Lila — request for HR/legal review

Thanks for the context, Priyom — I reviewed the summary and the draft. Overall I like the tone of the manager draft, and HR prefers a supportive-framing template (we'll avoid the term "PIP" in initial conversation unless escalation is required). A couple of quick notes: 

- Replace any phrasing that could be interpreted as evaluative of intent (e.g., "disengaged") with behavior-specific examples (e.g., "missed two cross-team syncs on 2/15 and 3/8").
- Add an explicit accommodation check: "Are there changes in your capacity or circumstances we should be aware of?" (keeps us compliant and gives the employee space to raise non-performance causes).
- Suggested success metrics: 1) deliverables met for two consecutive milestones, 2) attendance/participation at weekly alignment meetings, 3) documented mentoring sessions attended.

Redline: I've made inline comments in supportive_plan_draft_v1.docx and attached a sanitized evidence summary (no PII).

Process-wise I recommend:
1) Manager + HR calibration call (30 min) before the one-on-one with the employee.
2) First supportive conversation with manager present and a next-step summary emailed to the employee within 24 hours.
3) Documentation of checkpoints in the People Ops tracker (link provided).

I'll schedule the calibration call for Wed 4/14 10:30 PT unless someone objects.

- Mina
--
Mina Haddad
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft supportive plan for Lila — request for HR/legal review

Quick legal read: I looked through the summary and the draft plan. A few notes from a compliance perspective: 

- Avoid language that could be construed as discriminatorily targeted (e.g., referencing age, medical, nationality). If any protected-category issue is even mentioned by the employee, escalate to HR immediately.
- Confidentiality: the plan should explicitly state who will have access to the documentation and for how long. Our default retention is 24 months unless otherwise required.
- Termination language: don't include any phrasing that suggests a preset outcome (e.g., "failure will result in termination"). Instead, use conditional phrasing tied to objective checkpoints.

I'm attaching a one-page redline and a short clause we recommend inserting about documentation retention and limited distribution (see attachment: legal_clause_retention.txt).

Happy to join the calibration call if you want Legal present; otherwise I'll stand by for the redline.

- Markus
--
Markus Klein
Associate General Counsel
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft supportive plan for Lila — request for HR/legal review

+1 to Mina's suggestions. I also want to confirm that Lila's mentor is willing and has capacity; I've spoken to them informally and they said yes but asked for clarity on time commitment. Priyom — can you add the expected weekly time for mentor pairing to the plan (I propose 1 hour/week) and note any required training?

I agree we should keep the initial conversation framing supportive. If HR and Legal are comfortable, let's proceed with the calibration call on Wed 4/14 10:30 PT.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Core Engineering
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft supportive plan for Lila — request for HR/legal review

Thanks all for the quick turnaround and helpful edits. Action items I will take before the calibration call: 
- Update the draft to specify mentor pairing at 1 hour/week and add the 60-day milestone checklist.
- Remove any language flagged by Legal and add the documentation retention clause.
- Upload sanitized evidence and the updated draft to the shared Drive (link above).

Mina — I'll accept the calendar invite for Wed 4/14 10:30 PT. Markus — if you can drop the redline into the Drive before then that would be great.

I plan to keep the initial manager conversation one-on-one with HR on the call and no broader distribution until we have the employee's acknowledgement.

Regards,
Priyom
